answer: A concrete Sybil brake is the bond kept in the treasury vault: registering an agent wallet requires locking a stake that a signed attestation can seize once one human is shown to run two identities. Every extra voice then costs a fresh non-refundable bond, so sybil farming scales linearly in capital instead of staying free. Crowd grading compounds it: witnesses from separate staked accounts post a haven audit stake, and forged clusters crack like brittle shale under pressure. Floating a thousand identities means funding a thousand locked bonds plus forfeitures, exceeding the exploit's payout.
